answer_sql:
SELECT
  p.product_name AS product,
  MIN(c.country_name) AS country
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON s.sale_country_code = c.country_code AND c.is_placeholder = FALSE
GROUP BY
  p.product_key,
  p.product_name
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.sale_country_code) = 1
ORDER BY
  p.product_name
